The baby is wearing a white diaper with visible elastic ruffles at the leg openings. The baby's skin appears smooth and slightly shiny, typical of AI-generated infants. There are subtle artifacts in the hand/finger structure and background patterns.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers are fused together and lack distinct definition. The thumb appears to merge into the palm without a clear joint, a common AI artifact in hand generation.
The skin has an overly smooth, waxy, or plastic-like sheen, lacking the fine pore detail and natural imperfections of real human skin, especially around the cheeks and forehead.
The stripes on the yellow blanket warp slightly unnaturally around the baby's body, suggesting a slight depth map error or 'melting' of the background into the foreground subject.
There is gibberish text/watermark-like artifact ('O...') that resembles a logo but is illegible and structurally nonsensical, typical of AI image generators failing to render text.
